scope: One paused PhotoFramePreviewActivity on owned API34 AVD; real registry and emulated light sensor, actual Window.LayoutParams screenBrightness.
limits: ADB samples observe several monotonic intermediate window attributes and bounded ramp duration; they do not measure every 33ms callback, exact easing, idle scheduler work, physical panel output, or hidden/stopped cancellation. Retarget transport aperture is reported. Host object identity is inferred from process/activity/window, unchanged scene count and matching photo ROI.
privacy: Only scalar receipts and default-photo/synthetic-clock interior ROIs; no credentials, source URLs, complete profiles, raw hierarchy or raw logs.
